retrieval_policy.current_rule: Treat catalog text, normalized records, and URLs as discovery metadata only. The kickoff must remain usable without external retrieval.
later_job_requirements: Use only public or otherwise authorized access; do not bypass authentication, paywalls, robots controls, or technical restrictions.
Verify the publisher or institution, course and semester identity, resource type, and mapping to a specific unit.
Record canonical URL, retrieval timestamp, source revision when available, content hash, license or access basis, and local artifact path.
Keep restricted, copyrighted, sealed-reference, hidden-grader, and other learners' content out of learner-visible artifacts.
Distinguish official CS162 material, third-party commentary, alternate-course material, and manager-authored bridges.
Require a worker-controlled validator before any assignment can be promoted to completed.
retrieval_policy.failure_rule: If identity, rights, integrity, or unit mapping cannot be verified, retain the material as blocked or link-only and do not infer missing content.
